title: Share supporting questions across outputs
description:
Two checklist items depend on the same sub-question; ask it once and pay once.

Current: tasks belong to each output's config (classifier_config.py:28); the joint request keeps them separate (batched_classification.py:30-40), so a shared question is asked and paid twice; one output's answer can't feed another output's ML model (flywheel.py:584-595).

Desired: a cyclotron-level supporting question asked once whose features can feed several outputs' ML models.

Acceptance: appears once in the request; features reach both ML models; optimizer can propose shared questions recording their owners; usage drops vs a duplicated-question test.
